pages.title: Computronium Panel
pages.text: A panel of computronium with fine glowing traces running across its face, like a circuit board that is thinking. It is warm and faintly busy to the touch. The traces brighten when someone stands close, then fade once they walk away, as though the panel had finished noticing them.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Computronium walls were too warm as solid blocks. Thin panels gave me the look of a working computer without heating the room.
